svg.title: Diagnostic suppression and severity policy
svg.desc: The tidy-specific level adjuster moves to sawDiagnostic(), which edits the assembled diagnostic. Retains clangd suppression, NOLINT, system-macro filtering and warnings-as-errors. The nonempty-check guard is preserved: without active checks, tidy suppression and promotion remain disabled.

Retains clangd suppression, NOLINT, system-macro filtering and warnings-as-errors.
The nonempty-check guard is preserved: without active checks, tidy suppression and promotion remain disabled.
Colors follow git diff · unchanged context is gray · arrows map responsibilities, not entire excerpts
